Generate ONE genuinely transparent RGBA atlas arranged as EXACT 4 columns x 2 rows, EIGHT separate sprites, equally sized grid cells with generous transparent gutters. Use case: game nail-trimming component atlas. Generate ONE genuinely transparent RGBA 2x2 atlas of FOUR isolated upright cartoon claw sprites, equally spaced/cell-centered, same fixed lower ROOT anchor and scale in all cells, no grid lines or captions. Style: ivory white curved cat claw, dark brown outline, simple soft shading matching reference calico. A clearly visible PINK quick is INSIDE the lower third of each claw, not a paw pad. NO paw, hand, background or tool.
Top-left LONG UNTRIMMED claw: full sharp white curved tip, pink root well below tip.
Top-right SHALLOW CUT claw: a short piece of distal white tip removed, blunt cut edge, still too long, root unchanged.
Bottom-left PERFECT CUT claw: shortened blunt white tip, small white safety margin above pink quick, pink root fully intact.
Bottom-right TOO DEEP claw: blunt cut edge at upper boundary of pink quick, makes risk legible, but NO blood, torn tissue or injury gore.
Every root starts at same cell-relative point so engine can anchor components above separate paw. Claw length changes only at the tip. All clipped-tip fragments are omitted here because particle atlas supplies them. Keep all four fully visible with transparent padding, no horizontal guidelines baked into sprites; engine draws those dynamically.
Engine layout export of generated background only; no semantic image edits.
